items.title: The toll from the floods and landslides caused by heavy rains in Sri Lanka increases to 334 people killed and about 400 more missing.
The toll from the floods in Indonesia increases to 442 people killed and 402 more missing.
Croatia reports a record 74 new deaths in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide death toll to 1,786.
South Korea reports an outbreak of pathogenic H5N8 avian influenza at a farm in Jeongeup, North Jeolla Province, killing over 19,000 ducks.
M 7.1 - 1 km SE of Point MacKenzie, Alaska
Nigerian police killed 104 cattle thieves in operations in the north-western state of Zamfara.

Super Typhoon Durian (Reming), the strongest Typhoon to hit Philippines, impacts the Bicol region. In Virac Catanduanes 265–300 km/h (165–186 mph) wind was recorded, while in Legaspi, Albay 4.66 mm (0.183 in) of rain is recorded and a total of 740 people are killed.
At least 300 people were killed in clashes between Sudan's army and former rebels in the south earlier this week, aid workers say.
